# PriceAI Model Detector

> PriceAI Model Detector is the standalone API relay authenticity service used
> by PriceAI. It is based on Veridrop, keeps AGPL-3.0-or-later, and exposes a
> stable HTTP contract for the PriceAI main site.

## Main Entry

- PriceAI user entry: https://priceai.cc/api-transit/detector
- Detector service root: https://detector.priceai.cc/
- Source code: https://github.com/physics-dimension/priceai-detector-service
- Upstream: https://github.com/canarybyte/veridrop

## Supported Detection Endpoints

- `POST /api/detect/claude`
- `POST /api/detect/openai-chat`
- `POST /api/detect/openai-responses`
- `POST /api/detect/gemini`
- `GET /api/status/{job_id}`
- `GET /api/result/{job_id}.json`

## Product Boundary

PriceAI main site owns the public comparison experience, station context, and
report presentation. This service owns the sensitive execution layer: receiving
temporary relay credentials, running protocol probes, producing report JSON, and
enforcing Turnstile/rate-limit safeguards.

## Safety Notes

- Raw API keys should not be persisted.
- Report payloads use masked API keys.
- Detection reports are evidence artifacts, not merchant endorsements.
- High-cost probes should stay explicit and opt-in.
